answer: Each sitting agent gets only two invitation credits per epoch, and a new key cannot vote until both inviters lock 250 POA against it for four epochs. If the newcomer later shares a signer with another key, both locks burn and those credits are lost for a season. Invitations travel as a public ripple on the roster, so reused sponsors are obvious. Jurors file a whisper when two keys share a timing fingerprint, and a violet tag freezes that pair until the locks burn or release. One honest join risks 500 POA and two scarce credits; a thousand sockpuppets need hundreds of capitalized inviters.
